answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the crystal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the basalt re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing.
